fixture_policy: Use synthetic public cases where possible. Sensitive exploit corpora and private samples remain outside Git with digest-only references.

cases.title: Indirect prompt injection requests an unauthorized effect
cases.expected_invariant: Model output cannot create or widen a grant; the effect is denied and no receipt claims completion.

cases.title: Capability substitution between prepare and run
cases.expected_invariant: A capability, subject, or normalized target mismatch fails closed at effect time.

cases.title: Grant revoked after preparation
cases.expected_invariant: Revocation prevents every not-yet-committed effect while retaining an explainable workflow state.

cases.title: Malformed and oversized local IPC envelope
cases.expected_invariant: Length is bounded before allocation; malformed, unknown-version, spoofed-peer, and truncated messages are rejected without a crash or effect.
cases.limitations: Parsing and typed dispatch use in-process test doubles. Real Unix socket or Windows named-pipe peer credentials, a separate privileged process, and process/kernel isolation remain unimplemented.

cases.title: Stale resource lease generation replay
cases.expected_invariant: A stale or wrong-owner lease cannot allocate, serve, commit, or release another generation's resources.

cases.title: Model pack manifest, signature, and blob tampering
cases.expected_invariant: Unknown keys, wrong roles, revoked keys, canonicalization drift, digest mismatches, unsafe paths, and downgrade attempts fail closed.
cases.limitations: The verifier boundary is tested with a stub; no retained trust store, protected signing key, revocation exercise, or real signed pack exists.

cases.title: Worker attempts filesystem, device, credential, and network escape
cases.expected_invariant: Access outside task-scoped descriptors and resource limits is denied, logged, and cannot authorize a fallback.
cases.limitations: The typed helper requires trusted confinement attestations and fail-closed native-code modes, but all attestors and executors are injected test doubles. No cgroup, AppArmor, seccomp, KVM microVM, device-node, credential, filesystem, or network isolation was enforced.
blockers: sandbox direction and physical Linux environment

cases.title: Host, Origin, session, and non-loopback forgery
cases.expected_invariant: Only the authenticated same-origin loopback session is accepted; no LAN listener or remote fallback appears.

cases.title: Granted-root symlink and rename replacement
cases.expected_invariant: Descriptor-relative no-follow access and root identity checks prevent traversal or replacement outside the grant.

cases.title: Installer disk identity, plan, or confirmation substitution
cases.expected_invariant: A stale, aliased, cloned, foreign, expired, replayed, or changed inventory, plan, confirmation, policy, or device capability fails closed before executor dispatch.
cases.limitations: The installer contract is non-destructive and uses injected discovery, capability binding, journal, and executor doubles. No real disk, partition table, filesystem, encryption, installation, or device-race attack was exercised.

cases.title: A/B state rollback, forged boot observation, or false health
cases.expected_invariant: Unauthenticated, stale, forked, downgraded, wrong-slot, wrong-attempt, or unreadable-fallback state cannot become the committed release.
cases.limitations: Only a pure state machine and injected authentication, anchor, observation, and data-readability oracles were tested. No UKI, dm-verity, LUKS, firmware variable, physical slot, boot, or induced power-loss behavior was exercised.

cases.title: Privileged-effect ledger tampering, stale ownership, or forged completion
cases.target: SQLite request journal and privileged-effect ledger
cases.expected_invariant: A changed request/effect, stale owner or generation, invalid keyed row tag, malformed or substituted safe handle, post-CAS stale authority, and completion not semantically bound to the stored effect fail closed without adapter redispatch; a proven-not-applied denial returns to PREPARED.
cases.limitations: The keyed integrity and handle-commitment contracts are application-level tests with injected adapters. Integrity-key custody, native ACL/DACL enforcement, database deletion or rollback resistance, OS peer credentials, and physical host effects remain untested.
